chapters.title: RANGING
chapters.text: The TREND reading crossed back through 50, so the trend is off and the market is RANGING between 26,426.50 and 26,478.50 (the leg's extreme and the far side since).

chapters.title: RANGING
chapters.text: Price works inside the RANGE rails, 26,426.50 to 26,478.50, comes back to the range low and turns inside again. No trend is on, so no resume can be stamped.

chapters.title: TREND DOWN STARTED
chapters.text: The bar that closes below RANGE LOW 26,426.50 takes the TREND reading (50 bars) past one sigma down: it reads 14 on the 0–100 scale. The rails come off, and the trend stays on until the reading crosses back through 50.

chapters.title: RESUME SHORT
chapters.text: The pullback is over: SWING crossed back through 50 and this close held at or below the one before. STANDARD: the trend reads one sigma or better. HOLD 26,398.50, the pullback's high.
